moves.label: Quick Zanpakuto Check
moves.description: Fast high sword check with a tiny active window and guarded recovery.
moves.reason: Short standing sword poke hits high and returns to stance.

moves.label: Low Snow Sweep
moves.description: Slow low sweep with long active reach that cuts across the ankle line.
moves.reason: The leg/blade path stays low through the active frames.

moves.label: Kuchiki Body Slash
moves.description: Quick mid body slash with a brief active cut and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Forward slash travels through the torso line.

moves.label: Kuchiki Step Slash
moves.description: Slow mid step slash with long active reach and steady tracking.
moves.reason: Rukia steps forward into a compact mid-height blade cut.

moves.label: Flash Step Body Slash
moves.description: Slow mid slash with a tiny active hit and weak right tracking.
moves.reason: Long windup into the same forward body slash family.

moves.label: Rising Ice Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Upward lift and authored launcher height support the launcher name.

moves.label: Shirayuki Step Slash
moves.description: Fast mid step slash with a long active window and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Short command route uses the step-slash animation at mid height.

moves.label: Low Snow Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint with a tiny active strike and high recovery.
moves.reason: Low stance and floor-level strike read as a low feint.

moves.label: Low Snow Knockdown
moves.description: Slow low knockdown sweep with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Low sweep is already authored as a knockdown ender.

moves.label: Kuchiki Knockdown Slash
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown slash with brief active impact and high recovery.
moves.reason: Mid-height slash carries the existing knockdown flag.

moves.label: Sode no Shirayuki Ring
moves.description: Instant mid ice-ring rush with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Visible circular ice/snow effect justifies Rukia's zanpakuto naming.

moves.label: Crouch Ice Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch command transitions into a lifting slash with authored launch height.

moves.label: Overdrive Snow Check
moves.description: Quick high overdrive check with a modest active window and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive route uses the quick high sword-check family.

moves.label: Sode no Shirayuki Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown drive with huge active ice-ring pressure.
moves.reason: Long ice-ring sequence is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Overdrive Step Slash
moves.description: Fast mid overdrive step slash with a long active window and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command reuses the mid step-slash frames.

moves.label: Sidestep Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low sidestep sweep with long active reach and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep kick shares the low sweep animation family.

moves.label: Sidestep Step Slash
moves.description: Fast mid sidestep slash with a long active window and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep special uses the mid step-slash sequence.

moves.label: Rising Body Slash
moves.description: Slow mid while-rising slash with a modest active window and quick finish.
moves.reason: While-standing slash travels forward at body height.

moves.label: Rising Step Slash
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising slash with a tiny active hit and high recovery.
moves.reason: While-standing kick route shows the same compact mid step slash.

moves.label: Ducking Snow Check
moves.description: Quick high ducking check with a modest active window and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab uses the quick high sword-check frames.

moves.label: Ducking Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low ducking sweep with long active reach and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Down kick repeats the low sweep animation.

moves.label: Diagonal Ice Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with a tiny active lift and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward slash is authored as a launcher with weak-right tracking.

moves.label: Diagonal Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low diagonal sweep with long active reach and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward kick is the same low sweep family.

moves.label: Forward Blade Check
moves.description: Slow mid forward check with a tiny active sword poke and high recovery.
moves.reason: Forward input produces a compact mid blade check.

moves.label: Forward Body Slash
moves.description: Slow mid forward slash with a modest active window and quick finish.
moves.reason: Forward-heavy command uses the weak-right body slash sequence.

moves.label: Advancing Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low advancing sweep with long active reach and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Forward kick shares the low sweep animation.

moves.label: Shirayuki Quick Check
moves.description: Quick high quarter-circle check with a modest active window and fast recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab repeats the high sword-check frames.

moves.label: Shirayuki Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low quarter-circle sweep with long active reach and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick uses the low sweep family.

moves.label: Shirayuki Knockdown Slash
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown slash with brief active impact and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle slash is a mid knockdown ender.
